blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) is preparing for a possible visit of United States President Donald Trump to the Philippines in November this year. The trip remains unconfirmed though. This matter was mentioned by Misamis Occidental Rep. Sancho Fernando Oaminal on Thursday after conferring with officials of the department. Oaminal stood as the sponsor for the DFA’s proposed budget for 2027 worth P34 billion. A budget sponsor defends the proposed budget of an agency and answers questions during interpellations from fellow lawmakers.
